answer:
Here is what I would raise at your check-up, based on the records I can see.

1. Your stool test (FIT) from 4 November 2025 was positive. The records show no colonoscopy or other follow-up test after it. A positive FIT normally needs a colonoscopy to look for the cause, so please ask your doctor whether that has happened or is still needed. This is the most important item.

2. Your diabetes blood test (HbA1c) was last recorded on 16 February 2026, about eight and a half months ago. It was 6.9%, down from 8.3% in January 2025, so your numbers have improved. Diabetes usually needs this test every three to six months, so it is probably due now.

3. Your LDL ("bad") cholesterol was 131 mg/dL in February 2025, above the target of 99 or lower, and you started atorvastatin around then. The records show no cholesterol panel since then. A recheck is usually done a few weeks to a few months after starting a statin and then regularly. It may have been done somewhere the records do not show, so check with your doctor.

4. The records show no urine albumin test (a urine test for kidney protein leakage, sometimes called UACR). Your kidney filtration (eGFR) was 69 in February 2026, which is in the normal range. With diabetes, a yearly urine albumin test is usually recommended, so ask whether you have had one.

5. The records contain no vaccinations at all. This may only mean they are not in this record. At your age and with diabetes, your doctor can check which vaccines you are due.

6. The records show Jardiance started around February 2025 but have no start date for it, and metformin ended in April 2024. It would help to confirm with your doctor when you began Jardiance, so your medication history is complete.

One reassuring result: a chest CT in July 2025 showed no pulmonary embolism (a blood clot in the lung), and that suspicion was ruled out.
short: Positive FIT stool test from Nov 2025 with no follow-up colonoscopy recorded; HbA1c last checked Feb 2026 and likely due; no cholesterol recheck since starting atorvastatin in Feb 2025 (LDL 131); no urine albumin test recorded; no vaccinations recorded; Jardiance start date missing.
